scope: Close the 34 Harvard figure records previously unmatched by the registry. Pin historical images to their original release, preserve 33 images, and replace the unverified FGSM adaptation with the complete current author diagram. Local only.
source_review: Historical render commit c1c8e803d61c7c4f96bd1424ec5a0501f20f7730 serves byte-identical copies of all 34 imported files and 11 chapter HTML snapshots. Its stated source commit fc26c6257a96f4f6937a720b458db13e3bac070f contains 11 QMD files byte-identical to the snapshot's previously declared 2bd97c5 commit. Historical LICENSE.md, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, has the same SHA at both commits.

Inspected image placements and QMD source/credits: original direct artwork and course-generated TikZ/Python figures retain the historical license. The example digit augmentation is recorded as the original book panel, without assigning an unverified dataset or new authorship.

Two active historical drawings with additional credits: the poisoning adaptation names Li et al., Mathematics 12(2):247, Figure 1, CC BY 4.0 (publisher); the early-exit drawing credits Xin et al., EACL 2021, CC BY 4.0 (ACL materials policy). Record both the course rendition and the upstream work.

Legacy FGSM image credits a defence.AI adaptation; independent permission for that artwork was not verified. Keep the old bytes and caption in the historical record, use a pinned source link in the course reader, and no longer embed/distribute that image.

The current publisher's complete FGSM Geometry SVG is byte-identical at source commit c6861733e4dd4202ae4a396c96e3abe87ae103c7, Pages 7367c67c2afd6cbb42b9b2ac98cc673d2f5bba37, and the published asset URL. Its book component is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 per copyright page and pinned README. Do not crop or relabel it.
example_review: The geometry shows a negative first and positive second gradient component. Under the l-infinity bound the maximizing linear step is (-epsilon,+epsilon), unlike the direction of the raw gradient. The decision boundary crosses the drawn square; there is no guarantee of class change when it does not.
local_verification: Root build generated 2,063 pages; 259 output checks passed and built links had zero broken routes, fragments or files. Verified the targeted registry, public bytes, reading receipts and robustness arithmetic. Independent calculation enumerated the four permitted corners for gradient (-3,4), epsilon=0.1, and found maximum 0.7 at (-0.1,0.1). Confirmed all 33 retained Harvard files in rendered markup and matched distributed SHA-256. The retired figure is neither embedded nor present in the built files. A whole-site scan found zero unmatched local textbook img sources and 72 separate unresolved rights entries. Inspected Figure 8 at 1280 and 375 CSS pixels, including image expansion at 1.5x and license links; also verified the English fallback and pinned course archive link. No commit, push or deployment.

![[Assets/Sources/Harvard ML Systems/vol2/robust_ai/gradient-attack.svg|FGSM меняет пиксели в направлении знака градиента потери по входу]]

*Схематический шаг FGSM: градиент берут по входу, а не по весам.
Показанные классы, оценки уверенности и $\varepsilon$ принадлежат авторской
иллюстрации; незаметность зависит от масштаба и преобразований изображения.
Оригинальная иллюстрация из
[Robust AI](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol2/robust_ai/robust_ai.html);
[[05 Источники/Courses/Harvard ML Systems/vol2/robust_ai|локальный оригинал]].
Лицензия CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.*
changes.new:
![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/harvard-robustness-2026-11-09/fgsm-geometry.svg|Пунктирный квадрат вокруг x задаёт допустимое возмущение; FGSM перемещает x в левый верхний угол, за границу решения.]]

*Vijay Janapa Reddi и соавторы, [Scaling Machine Learning Systems,
рис. 8: Gradient-Based Attack Geometry](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol2/14_robust_ai/14_robust_ai.html#fig-gradient-attack),
[оригинал SVG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/c6861733e4dd4202ae4a396c96e3abe87ae103c7/books/vol2/14_robust_ai/images/svg/gradient-attack.svg),
[CC BY-NC-ND 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). Рисунок целиком, без изменений.*

Пунктирный квадрат охватывает все допустимые изменения входа $x$.
У синей стрелки градиента первая координата отрицательна, вторая
положительна. Поэтому красная стрелка идёт на $\varepsilon$ влево
и на $\varepsilon$ вверх. Как и в численном примере выше, обе
координаты меняются на полную величину $\varepsilon$, и шаг
заканчивается в углу квадрата. Здесь угол лежит за границей класса.
Если граница не пересекает квадрат, такой шаг класс не изменит.
